name: University of the West Indies - Cave Hill
summary: UWI's Barbados campus, with English-taught degrees across seven faculties and a broad undergraduate catalogue.

programmes.name: LL.B. Degree (Bachelor of Laws)
programmes.about: A three-year Bachelor of Laws providing a foundation in legal reasoning, written argument and substantive areas of Caribbean and international law.
programmes.overview: The LL.B. develops knowledge of legal rules alongside the skills needed to identify issues, assess arguments and prepare clear written legal opinions. Subject areas identified by the faculty include criminal law, real property law and international law, with particular attention to legal method. Students can use a dedicated law library and online Caribbean and international legal resources. The faculty also connects these skills to work in justice administration, public affairs and other settings where legal knowledge is valuable.
